name: Spinach and Provolone Stuffed Flank Steak Rolls
method: oven bake (sear then bake, sliced pinwheels)
note: Adjudicator KEEP upheld. Butterflied flank rolled around spinach/cream-cheese/provolone, seared then baked and sliced into pinwheels - a weigh-and-divide sliceable roast, 528 cal / 5g carbs, in-band and structurally low-carb. Cross-lane dedup against fresh accepted-slugs (20 entries): the only other flank plate accepted is flank-steak-parmesan-green-beans, a whole-muscle seared steak with dressed green beans - different method (stuffed-and-rolled bake vs seared-and-plated) and different plate, not a twin. Catalog-distinct per adjudicator (no braciole / stuffed flank / beef pinwheel in the 544-recipe digest; verified). Widens a catalog that skews American/Tex-Mex with a distinct Italian-American stuffed-steak dinner. Unmapped flank-steak + provolone are wanted pricer-lane signals. CROSS-PROTEIN WATCH: a spinach-and-cheese stuffed pork loin or stuffed chicken breast roll in another lane would be the same sear-then-bake-and-slice plate on a different protein - flagging for the merge pass, not resolving here.
